BE the Compiler · 《Head First Java》p42

Exercise · 你来当编译器 BE the Compiler

每个 Java 文件都是完整的源文件。判断能不能编译；不能就说明怎么修。

A
class StreamingSong {
  String title;
  String artist;
  int duration;

  void play() {
    System.out.println("Playing song");
  }

  void printDetails() {
    System.out.println("This is " + title +
                       " by " + artist);
  }
}

class StreamingSongTestDrive {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    song.artist = "The Beatles";
    song.title = "Come Together";
    song.play();
    song.printDetails();
  }
}
B
class Episode {
  int seriesNumber;
  int episodeNumber;

  void skipIntro() {
    System.out.println("Skipping intro...");
  }

  void skipToNext() {
    System.out.println("Loading next episode...");
  }
}

class EpisodeTestDrive {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Episode episode = new Episode();
    episode.seriesNumber = 4;
    episode.play();
    episode.skipIntro();
  }
}
